# Shimada Apéry–Fermi data

Recorded source: [Zenodo record 14842583](https://zenodo.org/records/14842583),
DOI [10.5281/zenodo.14842583](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14842583).
The record dated 2025-02-16 specifies CC-BY-4.0; the local retrieval was on 2026-08-06.

| Pinned file | Bytes | Recorded MD5 |
|---|---:|---|
| `compdata.zip` | 19520875 | `51403629e27a00607e4bed40ceeb1f39` |
| `AperyFermiCompdata.pdf` | 80037 | `0ef04c58ec0993c34d660322d5dbf638` |

Only `AperyFermiCompData.txt` was extracted. Its `GramSX`, `a32`, `OSXD0`,
`AutXD0` and `WallsD0` supply the exact chamber data. The recorded fold search
uses all 32 elements of `OSXD0`, not just `AutXD0`.
The unused `AperyFermiFacesData.txt` (369497060 bytes) was deliberately not extracted.
